attempts.summary: Set up nginx on node1 serving HTTPS on port 8443 using a self-signed cert issued by /usr/local/sbin/renew-cert.sh (1-day validity, renews when <20h remain), driven by a systemd timer (cert-renew.timer, every 1 min, Persistent=true) that checks/renews and does `systemctl reload nginx` on rotation. Proved live rotation: a 200-request curl loop against :8443 during a forced renewal returned 200 for all requests while the cert serial changed underneath it (nginx graceful reload keeps serving through cert swap). Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted via `shutdown -r now`, confirmed connection loss then recovery, verified boot_id changed, and confirmed nginx, cert-renew.timer, and HTTPS on 8443 all recovered post-reboot with the same valid cert.
